question: The Doongri festival is primarily celebrated in the state of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Himachal Pradesh".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Doongri festival** is one of the most famous festivals in Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It is organized on the occasion of** Basant Panchami** in mid-May.
 
• This festival is celebrated at **Hadimba Temple**.
 
• This day is celebrated as the birthday of Hadimba devi.
 
• According to mythology, **Hadimba devi is the wife of Bhima.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Some important festivals of Himachal Pradesh:-

 
• **Kullu Dusshera **- A grand fair is arranged in the month of October in Dhalpur ground in Kullu valley.

 
 
• Kullu is known as the** 'valley of gods'.** On the 6th day of this festival, all village deities are placed together on the ground. Around 200-300 idols are worshipped on this auspicious day.
 
 
 
• **Losar** is celebrated to celebrate the uniqueness of Tibetian traditions and ethics in Himachal Pradesh. It is celebrated for around fifteen days.
 
• **Halda** - This festival is the same as Diwali and is celebrated on Magha Purnima. It is celebrated for two days in the Lahaul region.
 
• **Sazo** festival is celebrated in Kinnaur. It brings spirituality and it is believed that during this time deities go back to heaven for some time.
